activity.notes: Frederick William, the 'Great Elector', ruled as Elector of Brandenburg from 1640 to 1688. This Person is distinct from Frederick William I of Prussia (the 'Soldier King'), who is already separately present in ATLAS. Although Frederick William also ruled Ducal Prussia and other Hohenzollern lands, the requested Activity is bound specifically to the Electorate of Brandenburg.

sources.title: Friedrich Wilhelm, Elector of Brandenburg (the 'Great Elector') — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Frederick William as Elector of Brandenburg and gives his rule as 1640–1688.

sources.title: Elector Frederick William, the Great Elector — Landeshauptstadt Potsdam
sources.citation_text: Potsdam's official city history identifies Frederick William as elector from 1640 to 1688.
